violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. The cutting boards for the prep coolers were gouged and stained. These are no longer a cleanable surface.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Faucet on the mop sink was dripping.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The floor in the walk in cooler in the corners and under the storage racks needs to be cleaned.
